properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the number of XSLTransforms in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified XSLTransforms object.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns an XSLTransform object in a collection.

parameters.name: Index
parameters.description: The individual object to be returned. Can be a Long indicating the ordinal position or a String representing the name of the individual object.

methods.name: Add
methods.signature: Add(Location As String, [Alias As Variant], [InstallForAllUsers As Boolean]) As XSLTransform
methods.description: Returns an XSLTransform object that represents an Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformation (XSLT) added to the collection of XSLTs for a specified schema.

parameters.name: Location
parameters.description: The path and file name of the XSLT. This may be a local file path, a network path, or an Internet address.

parameters.name: Alias
parameters.description: The name of the XSLT as it appears in the Schema Library.

parameters.name: InstallForAllUsers
parameters.description: True if all users that log on to a computer can access and use the new schema. The default is False.
